observations: Photo 0 shows a group of paperback books laid on a tiled floor; multiple motivational/business/relationship/self-development titles are visible.

Photo 1 shows more of the same set of books on the floor; several covers are readable (e.g., “Zero One”, “This Is Marketing”, “Sell Like Crazy”, “Women Rise Up”, “The Millionaire Next Door”, “Compound Effect”, “The Millionaire Mind”, “The Midas Touch”, “The Authority”, “Psychology of Money”, etc.).
No single book is shown close-up enough to confirm edition/year/condition details (pages, missing pages, water damage, spine wear).
A watermark text “EDENBOOKSTORE POSTED ON JIJI” appears on both photos, suggesting these are store-posted images.

claims.claim: Mativational, business, relationship and self development books
claims.evidence: Both photos show multiple book covers that match motivational/business/relationship/self-development themes (e.g., “Zero One”, “This Is Marketing”, “Women Rise Up”, “Bringing Out the Best in Your Marriage”, “Psychology of Money”).

risks.risk: Unclear quantity (how many books exactly) and whether it’s the full set shown in the photos or only some of them.
risks.proof: Ask for a count: “How many books are included? Please list titles and show a photo with all books laid out and counted.”
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a mixed bundle of used motivational/business/relationship paperbacks with unknown completeness (worst case: fewer books than shown).

risks.risk: Condition risk: possible torn covers, missing pages, water damage, or heavy spine/edge wear not visible from the wide shots.
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of 2–3 random books: front cover, spine, and the inside page near the first few pages (showing any damage).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used books in average/worn condition (worst case: some show noticeable wear).

risks.risk: Edition/printing risk: some titles may be older editions or reprints; value varies by edition and whether it’s a complete set.
risks.proof: Request photos of the copyright/ISBN page for 2–3 representative books (open to the page with ISBN).
risks.if_unproven: Priced without assuming special editions (worst case: standard used editions).

risks.risk: Authenticity risk: possibility of counterfeit/photocopy books (rare but possible in used markets).
risks.proof: Request ISBN/copyright page photos for at least 2 books.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as genuine used books only if ISBN pages confirm later; until then, treat as standard used value (worst case: no premium).

proof_requests: Confirm the exact number of books included (and whether it matches all titles shown in the photos).
Send a clear photo of all books laid out again, with titles facing up, so the count is verifiable.
Provide close-up photos of spines and the inside pages (copyright/ISBN page) for at least 2–3 books.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a bundle of motivational/business/relationship/self-development paperbacks, but the exact quantity and condition/edition details that drive the price are not verifiable from these wide shots.
